bsi.editorial_reason: 1 Samuel 22:6 places Saul at Gibeah on a height beneath the tamarisk; the pinned Hebrew rāmah is a common topographical noun, not independent evidence of another named town. The inherited possible identity with Gibeah.2 (Gibeah of Phinehas, Joshua 24:33) is a different homonymous location and cannot be asserted. Preserve the original historic Ramah.8 source record but withdraw its unsupported named-site key and false possible identity.
editorial_evidence: Pinned WLC 1Sam 22:6 o090220060112 Gibeah and o090220060142 height (רָמָה) are distinct word senses in the same passage
Lexical evidence https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7413.htm identifies a height/high place, not a distinct city at 1Sam 22:6
Gibeah.2 is the separate Gibeah of Phinehas in Joshua 24:33; no legitimate inherited site-merger evidence
